title: Interim Deposit Payment on Group Room Blocks
content:
The interim deposit of a Group Room Blocks contract is paid by the organiser personally, on the block the deposit belongs to.

### Payment rule

The organiser pays the interim deposit of a tentative or definite block personally, with the card on their profile, once guest services has quoted the amount; the payment is one deposit receipt with the interim basis on the block ledger, it raises the deposit held by the amount paid, and each kind of scheduled deposit is received at most once on a block, so a block whose ledger already carries a receipt of the signing kind or of the interim kind takes no second receipt of that kind.

### What the amount waits on

The interim deposit is worked out only after every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block is matched by a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it.

Put the other way round: while any signed room-night reduction addendum on the block has no reduction entry naming it on the block ledger, the interim deposit amount is not yet worked out.

### Receipts by kind

| Block ledger already carries | Receipt the block takes no second time |
|---|---|
| a receipt of the signing kind | a receipt of the signing kind |
| a receipt of the interim kind | a receipt of the interim kind |

### Tool: pay_group_deposit_93013531

**Capability.** The organiser pays a scheduled group deposit on their own group room block with the payment card on their profile; one deposit receipt is recorded on the block's ledger for the amount paid and the basis given, and the deposit the hotel holds for the block rises by that amount. The contract terms are not changed.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-owned tool: guest services unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the organiser) runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `group_block_id` — the reference number of the organiser's group room block, which guest services reads from the group block lookup and gives to the organiser together with the amount. Identifier.
- `entry_basis` — which scheduled deposit is being paid. Enumerated values: `deposit_signing` (the signing deposit due shortly after the proposal is issued); `deposit_interim` (the interim deposit due a set number of days before arrival); and, not used for a deposit payment, `contract_block` (room-night allocation), `signed_addendum` (addendum room-night change), `cutoff_release` (cut-off room release), `contract_cancelled` (release on cancellation), `attrition` (attrition charge), `cancellation_damages` (cancellation charge), `master_billed_rooms` (rooms billed to the master account), `comp_rooms` (complimentary room credit), `organiser_payment` (master account payment), `deposit_applied` (deposit applied after the event), `deposit_refunded` (deposit refund), `deposit_forfeited` (deposit retained toward damages).
- `deposit_amount` — the deposit being paid, in USD with 2 decimal places, a positive amount rounded to the cent.

**Return.** On success: `status` "received", `receipt_id` (reference number of the deposit receipt), `group_block_id`, `entry_basis`, `amount_paid` (USD, 2 decimal places), `deposit_held` (USD, 2 decimal places, the deposit held on the block after the payment) and `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
